title: Over-Limit Justification Records After a CGM Model Change (Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program)
content:
Documentation and prior-authorization unit standard — Continuous Glucose Monitoring Supply Program, Larkfield Medical Supply.

### Standard

A documented change of CGM model takes at-risk blocks off a sensor refill (A4239) on a tier where each refill requires the customer's own confirmation, drawing on the authorization grant resting on the newest written order of the item. It decides how many of the delivery's at-risk 30-day blocks the payer is expected to pay all the same; a block that comes off is no longer counted among the blocks at risk.

The records read are: the latest refill of the item (its ship date); the over-limit justification, the latest medical record on the CGM program whose purpose is over-limit justification, dated by the practitioner visit it records; and the customer's Insulin Pump Program — whether it is closed, and the pump delivery date recorded on it.

The blocks that come off are set by these rules:

1. When the customer's Insulin Pump Program is not closed, the pump delivery falls after the latest refill shipped, and the over-limit justification is dated on or after the pump delivery, up to the first two at-risk blocks come off, the payer being expected to pay them as the transition to the model the pump requires: the first two at-risk blocks come off, or every at-risk block when there are fewer than two.
2. When rule 1 does not hold, the over-limit justification is dated after the latest refill shipped and the pump delivery does not fall after it, the first at-risk block comes off, where there is one, the documented clinical change being expected to be paid for it only.
3. Otherwise no block comes off: every at-risk block stays at risk.

The pump delivery "falls after the latest refill shipped" when the pump delivery date is later than that refill's ship date; a pump delivered on the ship date itself, or a customer with no Insulin Pump Program, has no pump delivery falling after it.

### Condition table

| Insulin Pump Program | Pump delivery after the latest refill shipped | Over-limit justification dated | Blocks that come off |
|---|---|---|---|
| not closed | yes | on or after the pump delivery date | up to the first two at-risk blocks come off |
| not closed | yes | after the latest refill but before the pump delivery date | none |
| closed | yes | any date | none — the pump was still delivered after the refill |
| any, or none held | no | after the latest refill's ship date | the first at-risk block comes off |
| any, or none held | no | on or before the latest refill's ship date, or none on file | none |

### Hypothetical cases

- Latest refill shipped on a hypothetical 1 March; a pump delivered on the open Insulin Pump Program on 20 March; over-limit justification visit on 20 March. Rule 1: with three at-risk blocks, the first two come off and one stays at risk; with one at-risk block, it comes off.
- Same refill; no pump delivered after it; over-limit justification visit on 10 March. Rule 2: with three at-risk blocks, the first comes off and two stay at risk.
- Same refill; over-limit justification visit on 1 March, the refill's own ship date. Rule 2 does not hold, since the justification is not dated after the refill shipped.
